visual_text: PEG tubes not shown to help people live longer (low certainty, observational studies)
No study showed more comfort; quality of life never measured
More pressure sores with PEG in one study of 4,421 people
Careful hand feeding: what it involves (expert-proposed, not tested)
Stop at coughing, choking or distress
Note which foods, helpers and times work
Mouth care, talking and touch when eating becomes too hard
It is unlikely to stop weight loss
Saying no to a tube is a decision about one treatment. Food, drink, mouth care and company continue.
Davies et al., Cochrane 2021; AGS 2014; ESPEN 2024
alt_text: Comparison card on feeding tubes in advanced dementia. Left: no randomised trials; PEG not shown to help people live longer; no study showed more comfort; more pressure sores in one study of 4,421. Right: careful hand feeding, expert-proposed and untested. Saying no to a tube is a decision about one treatment; food, drink, mouth care and company continue.
